author: Michael Hanich
title: South Alabama soccer prepares for Sun Belt Conference opener against Troy - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Hanich ,
1 hours ago
Video above: ‘News 5 Now’ — Top Stories from Sept. 16, 2026
MOBILE, Ala. (WKRG) – The South Alabama Jaguars soccer team kicks off their Sun Belt opener against one of their biggest rivals, the Troy Trojans.
Argument over missing dog ends in deadly baseball bat attack in Thomasville South Alabama (2-4-1) will host Troy (1-5-2) on Thursday, Sept. 17, at 7 p.m. at The Cage, located at 6080 Old Shell Road in Mobile.
The Jaguars are 16-8-1 against the Trojans and are looking to make it eight consecutive wins. The last time these two teams faced each other was on Oct. 29, 2025, as the Jags took a 1-0 win to conclude the regular season.
South Alabama is coming off a 3-1 win over the Southeastern Louisiana Lions on Sept. 6. The team also currently has an eight-game home winning streak.
Troy is coming off a 3-3 draw against the Alcorn State Braves on Sunday, Sept. 13.
The theme of the match will be faculty and staff appreciation night. The program will also hand out ‘Beat Troy’ T-shirts at The Cage.
